tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task in the cached Todoist workspace with the provided fields (optionally assigning it to a project/section, making it a sub-task, setting due/deadline, order, assignee, and labels) and returns the created task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (for example empty content, invalid payload shapes, or unknown label IDs), NOT_FOUND when a referenced todoist_project_id/todoist_section_id/parent_todoist_task_id does not exist in the tenant cache, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID the task belongs to (references todoist_projects.todoist_project_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Todoist section ID the task belongs to (references todoist_sections.todoist_section_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Parent Todoist task ID for creating a sub-task (references todoist_tasks.todoist_task_id).

due.description: Due date object as stored by the backend (Todoist due payload).

deadline.description: Deadline object as stored by the backend (Todoist deadline payload).

labels_todoist_ids.description: Array of Todoist label IDs to apply to the task.

assignee_todoist_id.description: Todoist user ID of the assignee.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_quick_add_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a task by parsing quick_add_raw using Todoist-style Quick Add semantics (including extracting content, dates, labels, and optional project/section/parent context) and returns the created task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when quick_add_raw is empty or cannot be processed with the provided context, NOT_FOUND when the supplied todoist_project_id/todoist_section_id/parent_todoist_task_id does not exist in the tenant cache, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

quick_add_raw.description: Raw natural-language quick add input (e.g., 'Call Alex tomorrow at 5pm #Work').

todoist_project_id.description: Optional Todoist project ID context for parsing/creating (references todoist_projects.todoist_project_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Optional Todoist section ID context for parsing/creating (references todoist_sections.todoist_section_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Optional parent Todoist task ID to create as a sub-task (references todoist_tasks.todoist_task_id).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Returns a filtered list of tasks from the cached workspace, supporting filtering by project/section/parent/assignee/label, lifecycle status, free-text q, and sorting; results are paged using limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, invalid pagination arguments, or incompatible filters, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace. It raises NOT_FOUND only when a supplied todoist_project_id or todoist_section_id filter refers to an entity that is not present in the tenant cache.

todoist_project_id.description: Filter tasks by Todoist project ID (references todoist_projects.todoist_project_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Filter tasks by Todoist section ID (references todoist_sections.todoist_section_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent Todoist task ID (references todoist_tasks.todoist_task_id).

assignee_todoist_id.description: Filter tasks by assignee Todoist user ID.

label_todoist_id.description: Filter tasks that include a specific Todoist label ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single cached task by its internal id (td_task_...) including its current lifecycle state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id does not match the required pattern, NOT_FOUND when no task exists with that id in the tenant cache, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing cached task (including content/description/priority/due/deadline/labels/assignee/order) and may also move it by changing todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, or parent_todoist_task_id; returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid field values/payload shapes, attempts to set labels_todoist_ids containing unknown label IDs, or inconsistent placement (for example setting a section without a project context supported by the cache), NOT_FOUND when the task id or any referenced destination project/section/parent task does not exist, and CONFLICT when the requested change is not allowed due to lifecycle state (for example updating a soft-deleted task).

id.description: Internal cached task ID (td_task_...) to update.

todoist_project_id.description: Move/update task to this Todoist project ID (references todoist_projects.todoist_project_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Move/update task to this Todoist section ID (references todoist_sections.todoist_section_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Updated parent Todoist task ID to convert/move as a sub-task (references todoist_tasks.todoist_task_id).

order_index.description: Updated ordering position among sibling tasks.

due.description: Updated due date object as stored by the backend (Todoist due payload).

deadline.description: Updated deadline object as stored by the backend (Todoist deadline payload).

labels_todoist_ids.description: Replace labels with this array of Todoist label IDs.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a task by internal id (td_task_...) and returns the task record in deleted state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the task does not exist in the tenant cache, and CONFLICT when the task is already deleted or cannot transition to deleted from its current state. FORBIDDEN is raised when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

id.description: Internal cached task ID (td_task_...) to delete (soft-delete).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Marks a task as completed by internal id (td_task_...) and returns the updated task record including completion metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the task does not exist in the tenant cache, and CONFLICT when the task is already completed or is deleted and cannot be completed. FORBIDDEN is raised when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

id.description: Internal cached task ID (td_task_...) to mark complete.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_reopen_task
tool_schemas.description: Reopens a previously completed task by internal id (td_task_...) and returns the updated task record in active state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the task does not exist in the tenant cache, and CONFLICT when the task is not currently completed (or is deleted and cannot be reopened). FORBIDDEN is raised when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

id.description: Internal cached task ID (td_task_...) to reopen.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_search_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Searches tasks by query text against indexed task fields (including content and description where available) with optional scoping to project/section and filtering by status, assignee, and labels; results are paged using limit and an opaque cursor and returned sorted by sort_by and sort_order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for empty/invalid query, invalid enums, invalid pagination arguments, or label filters containing invalid IDs, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND only when a provided todoist_project_id or todoist_section_id scope does not exist in the tenant cache.

query.description: Search string to match against task content (and optionally other indexed text).

todoist_project_id.description: Optional Todoist project ID to scope the search to a single project.

todoist_section_id.description: Optional Todoist section ID to scope the search to a single section.

labels_todoist_ids.description: Filter tasks to those containing all of these Todoist label IDs.

assignee_todoist_id.description: Filter tasks by Todoist assignee ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_move_task
tool_schemas.description: Moves a task identified by todoist_task_id to exactly one destination: a different todoist_project_id, a different todoist_section_id, or under parent_todoist_task_id (moving its subtasks along with it when present), and returns the updated task record(s) for the moved task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when todoist_task_id is missing, when zero or more than one destination field is provided, or when destination values are invalid, NOT_FOUND when the task or destination project/section/parent task does not exist in the tenant cache, and CONFLICT when the move is not permitted due to lifecycle state (for example moving a deleted task) or would violate referential integrity. FORBIDDEN is raised when the caller is not authorized for the tenant workspace.

todoist_task_id.description: Todoist task ID of the task to move.

todoist_project_id.description: Destination Todoist project ID (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Destination Todoist section ID (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Destination parent Todoist task ID to make this task a subtask (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_bulk_move_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified tasks—and any subtasks they contain—to exactly one destination: a project, a section, or under a parent task, and returns the updated moved task records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if todoist_task_ids is empty or if you provide none or more than one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id. Raises NOT_FOUND if any taskId or destination entity does not exist (or is not visible in the current tenant), CONFLICT if the move would violate referential integrity (for example, making a task a subtask of itself/its descendant), and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to any referenced project/section/task or the operation is blocked by upstream Todoist permissions or rate limits.

todoist_task_ids.description: Array of Todoist task IDs to move.

todoist_project_id.description: Destination Todoist project ID (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

todoist_section_id.description: Destination Todoist section ID (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

parent_todoist_task_id.description: Destination parent Todoist task ID to make these tasks subtasks (provide exactly one of todoist_project_id, todoist_section_id, parent_todoist_task_id).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the workspace, returning up to limit projects plus an opaque cursor you can pass back to continue; when cursor is absent, the first page is returned, and when no further results exist the next cursor is omitted/empty. Results can be sorted by sort_by and sort_order, and include_archived controls whether archived projects are included alongside active ones. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an out-of-range limit or invalid sort values, and FORBIDDEN if the tenant is not authorized to read projects or access is denied by upstream Todoist permissions or rate limits.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived projects in addition to active ones.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_project
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single project by todoist_project_id and returns its stored representation, including its lifecycle status as tracked by this service. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if todoist_project_id is missing/empty. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist (or is not visible in the current tenant) and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access that project or upstream Todoist denies access/rate limits the request.

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID of the project to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project (optionally as a sub-project via parent_todoist_project_id) and returns the created project record as stored in the cache. Fields like color, is_favorite, view_style, and order_index are applied when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty or if parent_todoist_project_id is provided but invalid, NOT_FOUND if the specified parent project does not exist/visible, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to create projects or the operation is denied by upstream Todoist permissions or rate limits.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

view_style.description: Project view style (as stored by Todoist).

parent_todoist_project_id.description: Optional parent Todoist project ID to create this as a sub-project.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_project
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing project’s attributes and returns the updated project record; if status is provided, it performs the corresponding lifecycle transition (archive/unarchive/soft-delete) as supported by the service. You may also re-parent the project via parent_todoist_project_id and adjust order_index among siblings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid field values (including unsupported status), NOT_FOUND if the project (or new parent) does not exist/visible, CONFLICT if the update would create an invalid hierarchy (for example, parenting a project under itself/its descendant) or attempts an unsupported state transition, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized or upstream Todoist denies the change/rate limits the request.

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID of the project to update.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

view_style.description: Updated project view style (as stored by Todoist).

parent_todoist_project_id.description: Updated parent Todoist project ID to re-parent the project.

order_index.description: Updated ordering index among sibling projects.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_project
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the specified project by todoist_project_id and returns the updated project record reflecting its deleted lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if todoist_project_id is missing/empty. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist/visible, CONFLICT if the project is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to service lifecycle rules, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission or upstream Todoist denies the deletion/rate limits the request.

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID of the project to delete.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_sections
tool_schemas.description: Lists sections, optionally filtered to a single project via todoist_project_id and/or by lifecycle status, returning up to limit sections plus an opaque cursor for pagination. Sorting is controlled by sort and sort_direction, and you can continue a listing by supplying cursor from a prior response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort values or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if todoist_project_id is provided but the project does not exist/visible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read sections for the tenant/project or upstream Todoist denies access/rate limits the request.

todoist_project_id.description: If provided, return only sections belonging to this Todoist project ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the sort field.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_section
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new section within the specified project and returns the created section record. order_index is applied when provided to position the section within the project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if todoist_project_id or name is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist/visible, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to modify that project or upstream Todoist denies the change/rate limits the request.

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID to create the section within.

order_index.description: Position/order of the section within the project.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_section
tool_schemas.description: Updates a section’s attributes and returns the updated section record; if todoist_project_id is provided, the section is moved to the target project. name and order_index are updated when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values, NOT_FOUND if the section or destination project does not exist/visible, CONFLICT if the move/update would violate service integrity rules (for example, moving a deleted section), and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized or upstream Todoist denies the change/rate limits the request.

todoist_section_id.description: Todoist section ID of the section to update.

order_index.description: New position/order of the section within the project.

todoist_project_id.description: Move the section to a different Todoist project ID.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_section
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the specified section by todoist_section_id and returns the updated section record reflecting its deleted lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if todoist_section_id is missing/empty. Raises NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist/visible, CONFLICT if the section is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to service lifecycle rules, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission or upstream Todoist denies the deletion/rate limits the request.

todoist_section_id.description: Todoist section ID of the section to delete.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_label
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new label in the user’s cached Todoist workspace and returns the created label record. The request must include a non-empty name; optional color, order_index, and is_favorite are applied if provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields, UNAUTHORIZED if the tenant/user context is not permitted, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached, and CONFLICT if a label cannot be created due to a workspace-level constraint violation.

is_favorite.description: Whether the label is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_label
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single label by its Todoist label ID. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the ID is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if no label with that Todoist ID exists in the cache (including if it has been removed and is not available under that identifier).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels in the cached workspace, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and favorite flag, and returns results sorted as requested. Results are paged using limit and an opaque cursor; if more results are available, the response includes a next cursor to request the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging/sort parameters, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if read limits are exceeded.

is_favorite.description: If provided, filter labels by favorite flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the sort field.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_label
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing label identified by Todoist label ID and returns the updated label record, including soft-delete/restore via status. Only provided fields are changed; name/color/order_index/is_favorite/status are validated before applying. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values, UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have permission, NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist, QUOTA_EXCEEDED on write throttling, and CONFLICT if the update would violate a workspace constraint or an invalid lifecycle transition is requested.

todoist_label_id.description: Todoist label ID of the label to update.

is_favorite.description: Set whether the label is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_label
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a label by its internal cached label ID (td_lbl_...) and returns the updated label (or a deletion acknowledgement, depending on server configuration). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id does not match the required format, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the cached label ID does not exist, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the label is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to an enforced lifecycle rule.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_create_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment attached to either a task or a project and returns the created comment record. You must provide content and exactly one attachment target (todoist_task_id or todoist_project_id); optional attachment payload is stored with the comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content is missing/invalid or if the target is missing/ambiguous, UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access, NOT_FOUND if the target task/project does not exist, QUOTA_EXCEEDED on write limits, and CONFLICT if the comment cannot be created due to a lifecycle or integrity constraint.

todoist_task_id.description: Todoist task ID to attach the comment to (required if todoist_project_id is not provided).

todoist_project_id.description: Todoist project ID to attach the comment to (required if todoist_task_id is not provided).

attachment.description: Optional attachment payload for the comment.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_comment
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single comment by its internal cached comment ID (td_cmt_...). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the ID format is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, and NOT_FOUND if the comment ID does not exist in the cache or is not visible in the current tenant context.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_get_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for a specific task or project, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, and returns results sorted as requested. Results are paged using limit and an opaque cursor; provide the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither or both of todoist_task_id/todoist_project_id are provided or if paging/sort parameters are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the referenced task/project does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if read limits are exceeded.

todoist_task_id.description: Filter comments by Todoist task ID (required if todoist_project_id is not provided).

todoist_project_id.description: Filter comments by Todoist project ID (required if todoist_task_id is not provided).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_update_comment
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing comment by its internal cached comment ID (td_cmt_...) and returns the updated comment, including soft-delete/restore via status. Only provided fields are changed and validated before applying. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid content/attachment/status, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist, QUOTA_EXCEEDED on write throttling, and CONFLICT if the requested lifecycle transition is not allowed or the update would violate integrity constraints.

attachment.description: Updated attachment payload for the comment.

status.description: Update lifecycle status (e.g., soft-delete via status='deleted').

tool_schemas.name: todoist_delete_comment
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a comment by its internal cached comment ID (td_cmt_...) and returns the updated comment (or a deletion acknowledgement, depending on server configuration). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if comment_id does not match the required format, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the comment is already deleted or deletion is refused by lifecycle rules.

metadata.name: Todoist Extended MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a cached, multi-tenant representation of a user's Todoist workspace (projects, sections, tasks, labels, and comments) plus lifecycle state needed to support completion/reopen, moves, and soft-deletes.
